summary.whatChanges: Rewrites one e2e test for async leak detection: replaces the flaky `fs.readFile` (FSREQCALLBACK) scenario with an `fs.watch` (FSEVENTWRAP) one, and swaps the partial `toContain` assertion for a full inline snapshot of stderr including the "Async Leaks 1" header.
risks: Full inline snapshot of stderr is stricter than the previous substring match, so unrelated output/formatting changes will now fail this test
FSEVENTWRAP handle naming and fs.watch behavior are platform-dependent (macOS vs Linux), which may make the snapshot environment-specific
The unclosed watcher in the leaking case keeps a file watch open during the test run
